Parameter.name: APPLICATION
Parameter.Description: Class name of application this page belongs to.

XData.name: Style
XData.Description: This Style block contains page-specific CSS style definitions.
XData.Data:
<style type="text/css">
/* style for title bar */
#title {
	background: #C5D6D6;
	color: black;
	font-family: Verdana;
	font-size: 1.5em;
	font-weight: bold;
	padding: 5px;
	border-bottom: 1px solid black;
	text-align: center;
}
#logout {
	color: red;
	font-weight: bold;
}
</style>

XData.name: Contents
XData.Data:
<page xmlns="http://www.intersystems.com/zen" title="">
<hgroup width="100%" align="left"> <image id="TemplateLogo"/> <pane paneName="Banner" align="center" /> <button id="changeFunc" align="right" onclick="zenPage.changeWPage();" caption="Change"/> <button id="logout" align="right" onclick="zenPage.logout();" caption="Logout"/>
</hgroup>
<fieldSet id="systemInfo" align="left" width="100%" > <hgroup> <label value="System: " align="left" /> <label id="systemLbl"/> <spacer width="20"/> <label value="Namespace:"/> <label id="namespLbl"/> <spacer width="20"/> <label value="User:"/> <label id="userLbl" /> </hgroup> </fieldSet>
<hgroup>
<spacer height="10" /> </hgroup>
<pane paneName="PageContents" />
</page>
